label: Phase 001 and phase 004 contradict each other on SCHEMA_VERSION and both modify status-index.ts: 001 expects a bump to '3' while 004's setup and verify commands assert '2', so 004 breaks as soon as 001 lands. Edit 004's plan to assert '3' and state that 001 already bumped, or drop the bump from 001 and carry actor as a JSON column.

Phase 003 binds the terminal keys a=always and n=deny as answer text, but phase 006 records grant scope only from --scope and defaults a missing flag to once, and 003's plan writes only bots answer with no option. Pressing a or n therefore records scope once, so a deny from the screen grants once. Edit 003's REQ-006, REQ-009 and plan write path to pass --scope once|always|deny.

The parent spec says no child builds operators.json and that 001 lands the actor field alone, while phase 011 lands the operators.json roster and makes REQ-005 depend on it; 011 documents the deviation in its own decisions section. Replace parent spec.md:94 with a sentence that phase 011 lands the minimal two-role roster, and add operators.json to the phase-map row 11 dependencies.

operators.json has no write path: phase 011 lands the roster and makes it the sole authority for channel approvals, but its verbs are channel list|link|unlink|send|listen|drain, none of which adds or removes a roster member, and the spec names no path, format or creation rule. Add bots channel roster add|remove <actor> [--role owner|member] with the file at <stateRoot>/<identity>/operators.json, or document the exact path, JSON shape and creation rule plus an acceptance criterion for a hand-written second member.

Phase 010 requires every conversation message to carry by but defines it only for a human message; for a bot message it names botId and runId and leaves by unspecified, so null, the bot id and bot:<id> all satisfy the text. Add to REQ-003 that a bot message carries by: null (or bot:<id>) and mirror the choice in the acceptance criteria.

Phases 001 through 010 declare Phase N of 10 and phase 010 declares Successor None, while phase 011 declares 11 of 11 with predecessor 010-conversations and the parent phase map already carries eleven rows. A reader who trusts the metadata believes 010 is terminal. Change of 10 to of 11 in 001-010 and set 010's Successor to 011-messaging-channels.
